title: Smiley Sun
description: An smiling sun makes Minecraft brighter and happier.
body:
## ☀️ About this resource pack

This is a **wholesome visual tweak** that adds a joyful touch to your Minecraft world by giving the sun a permanent, friendly smile.

Every sunrise and sunset becomes a warm welcome, transforming the sky into a cheerful backdrop for your adventures. It brings a lighthearted, cozy vibe to the game, making your daily survival feel just a bit more positive and fun.

![Smiley Sun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/84bca686561980f572691e94b615236ccf6862ac_0.webp)

## ✨ Features

🎨 Custom smiling sun texture \
☀️ Bright and cheerful sky vibes \
💛 Seamless integration with vanilla Minecraft \
☕ Cozy and heartwarming atmosphere \
⚡ Zero performance impact (vanilla friendly)

![Smiley Sun](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/278aa20bdadbf2ad84fda01e7b0ea389766d37ab.png)

## 🧠 Perfect for

* cozy gameplay sessions
* cute or whimsical builds
* making survival mode feel less lonely
* taking adorable screenshots

![Other Project](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7ba796bfc60affed36e8d31b1f30e16414f79120.png)
